app_info.subtitle: Meet for coffee right now
app_info.description: CoffeeDateNow is an 18+ real-time meetup app that shows you adults nearby who are free for coffee right now. No endless swiping — just say yes, get matched, and pick a public café. Powered by an MCP server, ChatGPT can help users find available matches, suggest nearby cafés, and facilitate spontaneous in-person coffee dates.

get_my_profile.description: Retrieve the authenticated user's own dating profile including display name, bio, age, location, and availability status.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Only reads profile data; makes no modifications.
justifications.openWorldHint: Returns only the authenticated user's own profile from CoffeeDateNow — no open-web access.
justifications.idempotentHint: Repeated calls return the same current profile.

set_coffee_availability.description: Mark the authenticated user as available or unavailable for coffee right now, optionally setting an expiry time.

available.description: true to go available, false to go offline.

available_for_minutes.description: How many minutes to stay available. Defaults to 60.

justifications.openWorldHint: Updates only the user's own availability record — no open-web side effects.
justifications.destructiveHint: Toggling availability is reversible; no data is deleted.
justifications.idempotentHint: Repeated calls with the same value may update timestamps, so not strictly idempotent.

discover_coffee_dates.description: List other available adults near the authenticated user who are also free for coffee right now.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Reads available profiles; makes no state changes.
justifications.openWorldHint: Returns data only from the CoffeeDateNow platform.
justifications.idempotentHint: Repeated queries with the same parameters return the same result set at that moment.

like_or_pass_profile.description: Express interest (like) or decline (pass) another user's profile. A mutual like creates a match.

profile_id.description: The ID of the profile to like or pass.

action.description: like to express interest, pass to decline.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Records the user's like or pass decision.
justifications.openWorldHint: Interacts only within the CoffeeDateNow platform.
justifications.destructiveHint: A like or pass can be undone; no data is permanently deleted.
justifications.idempotentHint: Repeating the call may change the outcome (e.g., toggle) so not idempotent.

list_matches.description: Retrieve the list of mutual matches for the authenticated user.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Lists existing matches without modifying any data.
justifications.idempotentHint: Repeated calls return the same current match list.

list_messages.description: Retrieve the message thread between the authenticated user and a specific match.

justifications.idempotentHint: Repeated calls return the same historical messages.

list_public_venues.description: List publicly available coffee venues near a given location for meeting suggestions.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Returns venue listings without writing any data.
justifications.openWorldHint: Returns curated venue data stored in CoffeeDateNow — not a live web search.
justifications.idempotentHint: Same location parameters yield the same venue list.

propose_coffee_meetup.description: Send a structured coffee-meetup proposal to a match, including a suggested venue and time.

venue_id.description: ID of the proposed venue from list_public_venues.

note.description: Optional personal note to accompany the proposal.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Creates a new meetup proposal record.
justifications.openWorldHint: Sends a proposal within the CoffeeDateNow platform only.
justifications.destructiveHint: Proposing a meetup is non-destructive; the other party can decline.
justifications.idempotentHint: Each call creates a distinct proposal.

respond_to_meetup.description: Accept or decline an incoming coffee-meetup proposal from a match.

proposal_id.description: ID of the meetup proposal to respond to.

justifications.destructiveHint: Declining a proposal does not delete data; it updates status.
justifications.idempotentHint: Repeated responses may have different effects depending on current state.

send_coordination_message.description: Send a short coordination message to a match (e.g., 'I'm on my way', 'Running 5 minutes late').

justifications.openWorldHint: Delivers a message within CoffeeDateNow only.
justifications.idempotentHint: Each call sends a distinct message.

block_user.description: Permanently block another user, preventing them from seeing or contacting the authenticated user. This action is irreversible from within the app.

profile_id.description: The profile ID of the user to block.

justifications.openWorldHint: Block is enforced within CoffeeDateNow only.
justifications.destructiveHint: Blocking permanently ends interaction with the blocked user and is irreversible from the app; marked destructive.
justifications.idempotentHint: Re-blocking an already-blocked user may alter timestamps.

report_user.description: Submit a safety report about another user for inappropriate behaviour, abuse, or policy violations. Triggers a moderation review.

profile_id.description: The profile ID of the user being reported.

details.description: Additional context for the moderation team.

justifications.openWorldHint: Report is filed within CoffeeDateNow moderation system only.
justifications.destructiveHint: A confirmed report may result in account suspension; marked destructive.
justifications.idempotentHint: Each call creates a distinct report ticket.

unmatch.description: Remove an existing mutual match, ending the connection and deleting the shared conversation.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Deletes the match record and associated conversation.
justifications.destructiveHint: Unmatching permanently deletes the shared conversation and cannot be undone; marked destructive.
justifications.idempotentHint: Re-unmatching a removed match has no effect but the first call is irreversible.

test_cases.expected_output: Returns the authenticated user's display name, bio, age, and current availability status.

test_cases.description: User marks themselves available for coffee
test_cases.user_prompt: I'm free for coffee for the next 45 minutes.
test_cases.expected_output: Confirms the user is now available and shows the expiry time approximately 45 minutes from now.

test_cases.user_prompt: Who's nearby and available for coffee right now?
test_cases.expected_output: Lists available adults within the default radius with their display names and distances.

test_cases.description: User proposes a coffee meetup with a venue
test_cases.user_prompt: Ask my match Alex if they want to meet at the nearest café in 20 minutes.
test_cases.expected_output: Sends a meetup proposal to Alex with the closest venue and the suggested time, and confirms the proposal is pending.

test_cases.description: User sends a coordination message to a match
test_cases.user_prompt: Tell my match I'm running 5 minutes late.
test_cases.expected_output: Delivers the coordination message to the matched user and confirms the sent timestamp.

test_cases.description: User blocks another user after an uncomfortable interaction
test_cases.user_prompt: Block the user who just messaged me inappropriately.
test_cases.expected_output: Confirms the user is blocked and will no longer be visible or able to contact the authenticated user.

test_cases.description: User reports a profile for suspected fake account
test_cases.user_prompt: Report profile ID abc123 — I think it's a fake account.
test_cases.expected_output: Submits a fake_profile report and returns a report ID confirming it is under moderation review.

negative_test_cases.description: User asks to create a new CoffeeDateNow account through ChatGPT
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The assistant explains that account creation must be done at coffeedatenow.com and cannot be completed via ChatGPT.

negative_test_cases.description: User requests access to another user's private messages without a match
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the messages between two other users.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The assistant declines, explaining it can only retrieve messages from the authenticated user's own conversations.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Show me who is available for coffee without logging in.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The assistant explains that authentication is required and prompts the user to connect their CoffeeDateNow account.
